title: Expanded Equities sample queries across research workflows
points: The Equities page now shows a broader sample query library instead of only broad sector research prompts.

The prompt mix covers quick lookup, source-page retrieval, narrative filing evidence, ticker detail, company comparison, sector screening, deterministic modeling, model scenarios, PSX announcements, data-quality checks, macro context, and arithmetic transformations.
Added an equities-sample eval script that runs the public prompts through the query engine, checks expected lanes and answer shape, and asks an LLM judge to evaluate each answer.
